name: octamem
description: Long-term memory you own: save and recall facts, notes and decisions across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude and the OctaMem apps.

interface.longDescription:
OctaMem gives ChatGPT and Codex a persistent memory that belongs to you. Ask it to remember a decision, a preference or a project detail and it is saved to your OctaMem memory; ask about it days later in a new conversation and it is recalled.

- Remember once, recall everywhere: the same memory works in ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Cursor and the OctaMem web and desktop apps.
- You choose the memory: when you connect, you sign in to OctaMem and pick which memory to use (personal, work or a shared team memory).
- Full control: see and disconnect connected apps any time at platform.octamem.com > Settings > Connected apps. Disconnecting stops access immediately.
- Secure: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; access is limited to the one memory you chose.

Tools: search_memory (find relevant facts and past context), save_memory (store something you asked to remember), get_memory_info (show which memory is connected).
